verdict.rationale: Lambda's first-party filesystem docs describe an S3 adapter that lets developers use S3-compatible tools like rclone and s5cmd to copy files to and from attached regional filesystems, which directly meets the story's S3-compatible-endpoint and transfer-tooling criteria. The evidence consists of short doc snippets with little depth. missing for 10: details on endpoint setup, auth and throughput, documented sync with external cloud storage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
